body.bio: Mostly fantasy, some history, and the odd book about technology and society. Slowly working through the Malazan books.

reviews.title: Empire of AI
reviews.text: Careful reporting on how the big AI labs work. Worth reading next to The Coming Wave.

reviews.title: Going Postal
reviews.text: A con man made to run a dead post office. Funny all the way through, and the clacks gave me more to think about than I expected.

reviews.title: Chip War
reviews.text: A clear history of the chip industry. A bit long in the middle, but it explains why a few factories matter so much.

reviews.title: Deadhouse Gates
reviews.text: The Chain of Dogs is one of the best things I have read. It hurts, and it is meant to.

reviews.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
reviews.text: Third time through, and the long walk to Rivendell is still my favourite part.

reviews.title: The Pillars of the Earth
reviews.text: Forty years of building one cathedral, and I never wanted it to end.

reviews.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
reviews.text: The best revenge story there is. Long, but it never drags.

reviews.title: Deadhouse Gates

reviews.title: Fahrenheit 451
reviews.text: Short and sharp. It reads differently now than it did at school.
